'''Piar Nagelsa''' was a [[Kerkoiden/Legends|Kerkoiden]] [[General/Legends|general]] in the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], when the CIS fought against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] for control of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] from the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. Shortly before the [[First Battle of Plagen]], a [[Unidentified T-series tactical droid (Plagen)|T-series tactical droid]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] Nagelsa due to issues most [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|tactical droids]] had with serving under unfit organic leaders. It then discarded his tactical plan as it assumed [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] and led the CIS forces to win the battle.<ref name="Warfare" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nagelsa was mentioned in [[2012]]'s ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', an extensive [[Star Wars: Essential Guides|Guide]] on the conflicts in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="Warfare" />
